ttd.name: Olifant TTD
ttd.authority: Main ruled the South Africa line on 2026-11-02 (DECISIONS) on the owner's request the same day: the TTD (Project Loggim's one Tank Technology Demonstrator, 1992) as the South African special at tier IV, a photo-class first-party build; no registered 3D comparison exists. Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified.
ttd.envelopeBasis: TE's 7.78 x 3.62 x 2.99 m hull (2.99 m to the commander's CS60N head), the 51-calibre GT3 1.63 m past the nose on Bocquelet's side elevation (9.41 m over the gun; the build's 9.51 m holds the rear plate's lights and tow rings), seven 0.66 m dual road wheels at 0.81 m, the engine deck raised 0.26 m behind the turret; the envelope holds the loader's 7.62 mm and the whips.
